headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when KENTA went straight to headlining on debut in a Falls Count Anywhere match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.02 ? a real highlight of the night. AEW's first-ever televised crossover with New Japan ? a wild, chaotic Falls Count Anywhere brawl that spilled into the kitchen and backstage areas, later called one of the best Dynamite matches in a very long time.
Flash back to 2024, when Esfinge competed under the AEW banner for the first time against Castagnoli & Moxley & Star, appearing on Collision, rated 6.42.

Back on this day in 2023, Orange Cassidy vs. Lee Moriarty fought tooth and nail for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.27. Every title match carries a little extra weight, and this one was no exception.

secondaries.text: It was 2024 when Orange Cassidy vs. Tomohiro Ishii closed out Collision, rated 7.50 ? a strong outing.
Looking back to 2021, when AEW welcomed Cezar Bononi for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.44.

Back on this day in 2021, Darby Allin vs. Joey Janela fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.09 ? a well-worked match. It was the first title opportunity of Joey Janela's career.
